To: kimberly_park@redwood.com
Date: 2028-02-20T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Vendr onboarding request + quick evidence seed

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks for taking this — we run security at BrightCore and want to get our profile into Vendr for Redwood to verify our SIG/CAIQ answers and pull the SOC2 evidence. We have a current SOC 2 Type II (2027) and a partial CAIQ export ready.

Quick ask: can you confirm the preferred upload path (Vendr portal vs email) and whether Redwood needs any specific filename/manifest format? I can attach the SOC2 PDF and a lightweight CSV extract of CAIQ fragments for initial review.

Attachments: SOC2-Type2-2027.pdf (stub), CAIQ-fragment-2028.csv (stub)

Happy to hop on a 15-min call if helpful.

Regards,
Aisha Menon
BrightCore — Security Operations
security@brightcore.com
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: BrightCore Security <security@brightcore.com>
Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2028-02-20T10:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Vendr onboarding request + quick evidence seed

Hi Aisha — welcome, and thanks for sending this over.

Preferred flow: Vendr portal is best for onboarding (preserves proof-of-possession timestamps and role audit). Please accept the invite link I requested from our Vendr admin; if you prefer to upload directly to us, that also works but we prefer portal-first.

For a clean manifest please:
- Put the SOC2 PDF at root with filename: BrightCore_SOC2_Type2_2027.pdf
- Include a single CSV called BrightCore_CAIQ_fragment_2028.csv with the SIG/CAIQ control IDs in the first column and short answers in the second.
- If you have an internal contact for evidence questions, add them as a portal collaborator (we'll need at least one uploader).

Marissa (cc) will manage evidence review cadence on our side. Aditya — looping you in to flag any commercial notes for onboarding.

If you want, we can kick off a 30-min window tomorrow morning to do an initial pass together.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Security & Trust — Redwood Inference
From: aditya_rao@redwood.com
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2028-02-20T12:18:00-08:00

Kimberly — good plan. A couple of rapid notes from GTM:
- If BrightCore uploads to Vendr and grants us reader access, we can mark the mutual action plan as "evidence provided" in our CRM and move the opportunity forward.
- If there's any redline on the SOC expiry or scoping (PII/Prod), let me know — we often coordinate a short security confirmation call before a contract signature.

Marissa — can you set a 30-min slot for 02/21 at 10:00 PT for the review and assign the initial checklist items (SOC2 check + CAIQ coverage map)? I put a placeholder on the SUP-9876 ticket so we have traceability.

Thanks,
Aditya
Director, Strategic Accounts — Redwood Inference
